title: Air Scrubber Scope on Reassessed Water Losses — Insurance Claim Services
content:
On an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement, air scrubber scope arises only on a Water Damage Mitigation job dispatched at a tier that does not require an air scrubber: Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss, Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss and Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss. Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss and both Black Water tiers require one.

**Rule.** The air scrubber scope is set as follows: for a job dispatched at a tier that does not require an air scrubber whose recorded category is category 3, one air scrubber for every air mover day billed at the Black Water air scrubber daily rate, because every Black Water tier requires one; for such a job whose recorded category is category 2 and whose affected area is at or above the Large Loss threshold, one air scrubber per air mover day at the Gray Water Large Loss air scrubber rate; otherwise no air scrubber scope.

An air mover day is a calendar day on which an air mover line is billed on the job — the job books one air mover line per day — whatever the number of air movers on that line.

## Rates and threshold

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Large Loss threshold (affected area) | 2000 square feet |
| Black Water air scrubber daily rate, Standard Loss | 78.60 |
| Black Water air scrubber daily rate, Large Loss | 70.74 |
| Gray Water Large Loss air scrubber daily rate | 70.74 |

## Outcomes

| Tier requires an air scrubber | Recorded category | Affected area | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| no | category 3 | below 2000 | air mover days multiplied by 78.60 |
| no | category 3 | 2000 or more | air mover days multiplied by 70.74 |
| no | category 2 | 2000 or more | air mover days multiplied by 70.74 |
| no | category 2 | below 2000 | none |
| yes | any | any | none |

*Hypothetical:* air mover lines billed on 7 days on a Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss job of 1260 square feet recorded category 3: 7 multiplied by 78.60 is 550.20.
